@sentry/react-native.reason: Keep the Sentry 8 integration and its native crash symbol configuration.

react-native-gesture-handler.reason: Retain Gesture Handler 3.3 and the existing gesture API; validate its native integration as part of the coordinated Expo 58 runtime build.

react-native-reanimated.reason: Reanimated 4.7.0 explicitly supports React Native 0.88 and Worklets 0.13 in its published compatibility.json; the SDK recommendation 4.6.0 does not include React Native 0.88.

react-native-safe-area-context.reason: Retain the current safe-area native integration while validating the coordinated Expo 58 runtime.

react-native-worklets.reason: Worklets 0.13.0 explicitly supports React Native 0.88 in its published compatibility.json and is the required pair for Reanimated 4.7.0.

@babel/core.reason: Babel 8 compiles test fixtures. Expo and Worklets retain an explicit Babel 7 adapter until those upstream transforms support Babel 8.

typescript.reason: TypeScript 7 checks the app and crash-reporting workspace. ESLint uses the official TypeScript 6 compatibility package for its compiler API.
